scripts.name: P40DC.RoGaugeCoupler.RoGaugeCouplerScript
scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

local coupler = script.Parent

local DCCPermissions = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("DCCPermissions")
local function GetPermission()
	-- if DCCPermissions isn't found, everything is allowed
	return true
end
if DCCPermissions then
	-- if DCCPermissions is found, get permission
	DCCPermissions = require(DCCPermissions)
	function GetPermission(player,action)
		return DCCPermissions.GetPermission(player,action)
	end
end

local Allow = coupler:FindFirstChild("Allow")
local CoupledTo = coupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo")
local DelayedTo = coupler:FindFirstChild("DelayedTo")
local remote = coupler:FindFirstChild("ROBLOXInteractionEvent")
local Attachment = coupler:FindFirstChild("Attachment")

if not Allow then
	Allow = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	Allow.Name = "Allow"
	Allow.Value = true
	Allow.Parent = coupler
end
if not CoupledTo then
	CoupledTo = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	CoupledTo.Name = "CoupledTo"
	CoupledTo.Parent = coupler
end
if not DelayedTo then
	DelayedTo = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	DelayedTo.Name = "DelayedTo"
	DelayedTo.Parent = coupler
end
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "ROBLOXInteractionEvent"
	remote.Parent = coupler
end
if not Attachment then
	Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment.Axis = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
	Attachment.Parent = coupler
end

local Rod -- the rod itself
local RodConnection -- connection to decouple if the rod disappears

local TouchedConnection

local function Recolor()--this makes the indicator change colors
	if CoupledTo.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green") -- green means coupled
	elseif DelayedTo.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue") -- orange means delayed (will automatically set Allow once delayed coupler is out of range)
	elseif Allow.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow") -- yellow means ready to couple
	else
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red") -- red means will not couple
	end
end
Recolor()

do --[[ Create a coupling ]]--
	
	local function GetCouplerOwner(otherCoupler)
		-- sets the network owner of the coupler to the server
		-- and determines who should get control of the coupler after coupling
		
		local owner = coupler:GetNetworkOwner() -- network owner of our coupler
		local otherOwner = otherCoupler:GetNetworkOwner() -- network owner of the other coupler
		
		local ownerAuto = coupler:GetNetworkOwnershipAuto() -- auto ownership of our coupler
		local otherOwnerAuto = otherCoupler:GetNetworkOwnershipAuto() -- auto ownership of other coupler
		
		-- set both coupler ownerships to server to perform the coupling
		if coupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			coupler:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end
		if otherCoupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			coupler:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end
		
		local NewCouplerOwner
		-- nil means set the network owner to the server
		-- false is taken to mean set network ownership auto
		
		if NewCouplerOwner and otherOwnerAuto then
			-- if both couplers were set to automatic ownership, set automatic ownership
			NewCouplerOwner = false
		elseif ownerAuto then
			-- if this coupler has automatic ownership and the other doesn't, set it to the owner of the other coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = otherOwner
		elseif otherOwnerAuto then
			-- if the other coupler has automatic ownership and this coupler doesn't, set it to the owner of this coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = owner
		else
			-- if neither coupler had automatic ownership, set ownership to the owner of this coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = owner
		end
		
		return NewCouplerOwner
	end
	
	local function RestoreCouplerOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
		-- sets the ownership or auto ownership of the coupler after coupling
		if coupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			if NewCouplerOwner == false then
				-- auto ownership
				coupler:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
			else
				-- any other kind of ownership (including server)
				coupler:SetNetworkOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
			end
		end
	end
	
	function RemoveTouchedConnection()
		-- disconnect the TouchedConnection because they create a lot of lag with Ro-Gauge trains
		if TouchedConnection then
			TouchedConnection:disconnect()
			TouchedConnection = nil
		end
	end
	
	local function Couple(OtherCoupler)
		-- set the coupler parts to cancollide false so they don't interfere with each other when coupled
		coupler.CanCollide = false
		OtherCoupler.CanCollide = false
		
		Rod = Instance.new("RodConstraint")
		Rod.Name = "RoGaugeRod"
		Rod.Visible = false
		Rod.Length = coupler.Size.Z/2+OtherCoupler.Size.Z/2
		Rod.Attachment0 = Attachment
		Rod.Attachment1 = OtherCoupler.Attachment
		Rod.Parent = coupler
		CreateRodConnection()
		
		CoupledTo.Value = OtherCoupler
		OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = coupler
		if coupler:FindFirstChild("CoupleSound") then
			coupler.CoupleSound:Play()
		end
	end
	
	local function HandleTouched(OtherCoupler)
		if not Allow.Value or CoupledTo.Value then
			-- if we aren't allowing or we are already coupled, ignore
			return
		end
		if OtherCoupler.Name ~= "RoGaugeCoupler" then
			-- if the part is not a RoGaugeCoupler, ignore
			return
		end
		local OtherAllow = OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("Allow")
		local OtherCoupledTo = OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo")
		
		if OtherCoupledTo.Value or OtherAllow.Value == false then
			-- if the other coupler is coupled or it is not allowing, ignore
			return
		end
		-- lets couple
		-- set network owner to server to perform coupling
		local NewCouplerOwner = GetCouplerOwner(OtherCoupler)
		-- perform coupling
		Couple(OtherCoupler)
		RemoveTouchedConnection()
		-- set network owner to the deserving party
		RestoreCouplerOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
	end
	
	function AddTouchedConnection()
		if TouchedConnection then
			return
		end
		TouchedConnection = coupler.Touched:connect(HandleTouched)
	end
	AddTouchedConnection()
end

do --[[ Destroy a coupling ]]--
	local function DelayCouplers()
		local OtherCoupler = CoupledTo.Value
		OtherCoupler.DelayedTo.Value = coupler -- set the other coupler's DelayedTo value
		DelayedTo.Value = CoupledTo.Value -- set this coupler's DelayedTo value
		
		-- insert a spring connecting the two couplers with zero force
		-- this forces them to be the same mechanism and thus the same network owner
		local s = Instance.new("SpringConstraint")
		s.Name = "RoGaugeSpring"
		s.Damping = 0
		s.MaxForce = 0
		s.Stiffness = 0
		s.Visible = false
		s.Attachment0 = Attachment
		s.Attachment1 = OtherCoupler.Attachment
		s.Parent = coupler
		CoupledTo.Value = nil
		OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = nil
	end
	
	local function Decouple()
		coupler.CanCollide = true
		Allow.Value = false--this makes it so that it won't re-connect right after you uncouple
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			local OtherCoupler = CoupledTo.Value
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeRod") then
				-- delete the coupler connection
				OtherCoupler.RoGaugeRod:Destroy()
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("Allow") then
				-- set it to not couple back up immediately
				OtherCoupler.Allow.Value = false
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo") then
				-- set it so it isn't coupled
				OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = nil
			end
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("DecoupleSound") then
				coupler.DecoupleSound:Play()
			end
		end
		if RodConnection then
			RodConnection:Disconnect()
			RodConnection = nil
		end
		if Rod then
			Rod:Destroy()
		end
		Recolor()
		CoupledTo.Value = nil
		if DelayedTo.Value then
			local OtherCoupler = DelayedTo.Value
			local Halflength = OtherCoupler.Size.Z/2+coupler.Size.Z/2
			while (OtherCoupler.Position-coupler.Position).magnitude < Halflength*1.5 and DelayedTo.Value == OtherCoupler do
				wait()
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				OtherCoupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				coupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			DelayedTo.Value = nil
			Allow.Value = true
			Recolor()
		end
		AddTouchedConnection()
	end
	
	local function HandlePlayerInput(player)
		-- user input
		if not GetPermission(player,"Coupling") then
			return
		end
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			-- if we are coupled, uncoupled
			DelayCouplers()
			Recolor()
		elseif DelayedTo.Value then
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				coupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			DelayedTo.Value = nil
			Allow.Value = false
			Recolor()
		else
			-- otherwise, toggle Allow
			Allow.Value = not Allow.Value
			if Allow.Value then
				AddTouchedConnection()
			else
				RemoveTouchedConnection()
			end
			Recolor()
		end
	end
	
	remote.OnServerEvent:connect(HandlePlayerInput)
	
	function CreateRodConnection()
		if RodConnection then return end
		RodConnection = Rod.AncestryChanged:connect(function(parent,parento)
			if not parento then
				RodConnection:Disconnect()
				RodConnection = nil
				Decouple()
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local function GetRod()
		if Rod then return end
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			Rod = CoupledTo.Value:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeRod")
			if Rod then
				CreateRodConnection()
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function CoupledToChanged()
		-- if we get the message to decouple, do so
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			GetRod()
			Recolor()
		else
			Decouple()
		end
	end
	
	CoupledTo.Changed:connect(CoupledToChanged)
end

scripts.name: P40DC.DCCLocomotiveScript
scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

-- The script that controls DCC-equipped trains

-- this is necessary to prevent issues with scripts fighting for control of each other
if script.Parent == workspace then
	return
end

local Locomotive = script.Parent
local Properties = Locomotive.DCCProperties
local Base = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("Base",true)

local DCCSystem = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("DCCSystem")
local LocoModule = DCCSystem.LocoModule
local Loco = require(LocoModule)
local k = Loco.new(Locomotive)

local Throttle = 0
local TargetVelocity = 0
local Velocity = 0

local SetTargetVelocity -- instantiating upvalue in the script's global context to allow trans-scope functions
local QuitDriving
local StopFunctions
local UpdateFunctions
local UpdateFunctionsVelocity
		
local PhysicsOwner

do --[[ Input Control ]]--
	
	function k.ControlLoco(data)
		-- give the loco input
		if data == "Stop" then
			QuitDriving()
			return
		end
		if data.Throttle then -- Throttle is last in line because it hogs the thread to do speed control
			Throttle = data.Throttle
			SetTargetVelocity()
		end
		UpdateFunctions(data)
	end
	
	function k.SetOwner(player)
		-- set the network owner
		if PhysicsOwner then
			script.NetworkControlRemote:FireClient(PhysicsOwner,"StopSimulating")
		end
		if player then
			script.NetworkControlRemote:FireClient(player,"StartSimulating")
		end
		PhysicsOwner = player
		if not Base:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			return
		end
		if player then
			Base:SetNetworkOwner(player)
		else
			Base:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
		end
	end
end
	
do --[[ Address Control ]]--
	local Address
	local ConsistAddress
	local CabNumberLabels = {}
	local CabNumberModules = {}
	
	for _,p in ipairs (Locomotive:GetDescendants()) do
		if p.Name == "CabNumberLabel" then
			table.insert(CabNumberLabels,p)
		elseif p.Name == "CabNumberModule" then
			table.insert(CabNumberModules,require(p))
		end
	end
		
	local function UpdateCabNumbers()
		for _,p in ipairs (CabNumberLabels) do
			p.Text = tostring(Address)
		end
		for _,p in ipairs (CabNumberModules) do
			p(Address)
		end
	end
	
	-- register the address
	Address = k:SetAddress(Properties.DCCAddress.Value,Properties.UniqueDCCAddress.Value)
	Properties.DCCAddress.Value = Address
	UpdateCabNumbers()
	-- register the consist address
	ConsistAddress = Properties.ConsistAddress.Value
	k:SetConsistAddress(Properties.ConsistAddress.Value)
	
	-- allow server to change the DCC Address on the fly
	Properties.DCCAddress.Changed:connect(function(newval)
		if newval ~= Address then
			Address = k:SetAddress(newval,Properties.UniqueDCCAddress.Value)
			Properties.DCCAddress.Value = Address
			UpdateCabNumbers()
		end
	end)
	-- toggling UniqueDCCAddress will force it to claim a new address
	Properties.UniqueDCCAddress.Changed:connect(function(newval)
		if newval then
			Address = k:SetAddress(Address,true)
			Properties.DCCAddress.Value = Address
			UpdateCabNumbers()
		end
	end)
	
	-- allow server to change the Consist Address on the fly
	Properties.ConsistAddress.Changed:connect(function(newval)
		if newval ~= ConsistAddress then
			ConsistAddress = k:SetConsistAddress(newval)
		end
	end)
end

do --[[ Functions ]]--
	local FunctionsFolder = Locomotive.DCCFunctions
	local FunctionModules = {}
	for _,m in ipairs (FunctionsFolder:GetChildren()) do
		local j = require(m)
		table.insert(FunctionModules,j)
	end
	
	function StopFunctions()
		for _,m in ipairs (FunctionModules) do
			m.Stop()
		end
	end
	
	function UpdateFunctions(data)
		for _,m in ipairs (FunctionModules) do
			if m.Invoke then
				m.Invoke(data)
			end
		end
	end
	
	function UpdateFunctionsVelocity(velocity)
		for _,m in ipairs (FunctionModules) do
			if m.UpdateVelocity then
				m.UpdateVelocity(velocity)
			end
		end
	end
end

do --[[ Speed Control ]]--
	
	local DriveModule = require(script.DriveModule)
	
	function SetTargetVelocity()
		TargetVelocity = Throttle*Properties.MaxSpeed.Value*(Properties.DirectionReversed.Value and -1 or 1)
	end

	function QuitDriving()
		TargetVelocity = 0 -- by setting these all to zero, the train will always have the same settings when a new controller picks it up
		Throttle = 0
		StopFunctions()
	end
	
	while script.Parent ~= nil do
	-- this is important at least in module scripts because otherwise the loop will never end
	-- maybe it doesn't actually update the script's Parent property when it gets deleted, but I hope it does
		Deceleration = Properties.Deceleration.Value
		Acceleration = Properties.Acceleration.Value
		t = wait()
		if Velocity ~= TargetVelocity then
			-- if we need to tween, tween
			local VIsAbove = Velocity > TargetVelocity and -1 or 1
			local IsDecelerating =  VIsAbove*Velocity/math.abs(Velocity) == -1
			
			if IsDecelerating then
				Velocity = Deceleration > 0 and (Velocity + VIsAbove*t*Deceleration) or TargetVelocity
			else
				Velocity = Acceleration > 0 and (Velocity + VIsAbove*t*Acceleration) or TargetVelocity
			end
			if (Velocity > TargetVelocity and -1 or 1)~= VIsAbove then
				-- if we passed the target, set it to the target so it's not bouncing up and down
				Velocity = TargetVelocity
			end
		end
		DriveModule(Velocity)
		UpdateFunctionsVelocity(Velocity)
		if PhysicsOwner then
			script.NetworkControlRemote:FireClient(PhysicsOwner,Velocity)
		end
	end
end

scripts.name: P40DC.DCCLocomotiveScript.DriveModule
scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

-- this is broken into a module on its own so the client can use it easily

local Locomotive = script.Parent.Parent
local Properties = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("DCCProperties",true)

local Engines = {}

for _,p in ipairs (Locomotive:GetDescendants()) do
	if p.Name == "BV" then
		table.insert(Engines,p)
	end
end

local Acceleration,Deceleration,direction,vectorpower -- zomg c programming

return function(Velocity)
	
	for _,vel in ipairs (Engines) do
		-- set the properties of the engines
		direction = vel.Parent.CFrame.lookVector
		vectorpower = Properties.MaxPower.Value*direction
		vel.MaxForce = Vector3.new(vectorpower.X>0 and vectorpower.X or -vectorpower.X,
			vectorpower.Y>0 and vectorpower.Y or -vectorpower.Y,
			vectorpower.Z>0 and vectorpower.Z or -vectorpower.Z
		)
		vel.Velocity = Velocity*direction
	end
end

scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

-- generic function module
-- module.Invoke MAY NOT YIELD!!!

-- module for turning on and off the lights

local Locomotive = script.Parent.Parent
local Base = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("Base",true)

local HornSound = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("HornSound",true)
local WhistleParticle = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("WhistleParticle",true)

local module = {}
local LastHornActivation = 0

local function DoHorn()
	local CurrentTime = tick()
	LastHornActivation = CurrentTime
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		HornSound:Stop()
		HornSound:Play()
		if WhistleParticle then
			-- allow for whistles too
			WhistleParticle.Enabled = true
		end
		wait(HornSound.TimeLength/HornSound.PlaybackSpeed)
		if LastHornActivation == CurrentTime and WhistleParticle then
			-- horn was not honked since last honk
			WhistleParticle.Enabled = false
		end
	end))
end

function module.Invoke(data) -- the main function
	-- must not yield or things will break
	if data.Horn then
		DoHorn()
	end
end

function module.Stop()
	-- this function is called when the Stop command is sent to the locomotive
end
	
module.Stop()

return module

scripts.name: P40DC.DCCFunctions.DieselSounds
scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

-- module specifically for playing running sounds

-- module for turning on and off the lights

local Locomotive = script.Parent.Parent
local RunSound = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("RunSound",true)

local RunSoundIsPlaying = false

local RunSoundIdleVolume = 0.5
local RunSoundMaxVolume = 1
local RunSoundFullVolumeSpeed = 10

local RunSoundIdlePitch = 1
local RunSoundMaxPitch = 2
local RunSoundFullPitchSpeed = 10

local Velocity = 0

local module = {}

local function UpdateSounds()
	local VAbs = math.abs(Velocity)
	if not RunSoundIsPlaying then
		RunSoundIsPlaying = true
		RunSound:Play()
	end
	if VAbs < RunSoundFullVolumeSpeed then
		RunSound.Volume = RunSoundIdleVolume + VAbs/RunSoundFullVolumeSpeed*(RunSoundMaxVolume-RunSoundIdleVolume)
	else
		RunSound.Volume = RunSoundMaxVolume
	end
	if VAbs < RunSoundFullPitchSpeed then
		RunSound.Pitch = RunSoundIdlePitch + VAbs/RunSoundFullPitchSpeed*(RunSoundMaxPitch-RunSoundIdlePitch)
	else
		RunSound.Pitch = RunSoundMaxPitch
	end
end

function module.UpdateVelocity(velocity) -- the main function
	Velocity = velocity
	UpdateSounds()
end

function module.Stop()
	-- this function is called when the Stop command is sent to the locomotive
	
end

module.Stop()

return module

local Locomotive = script.Parent.Parent
local Base = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("Base",true)
local BellSound = Locomotive:FindFirstChild("BellSound",true)

local module = {}
local BellOff = false




local function HandleBell()
	if BellOff == false then
		BellSound:Play()
		BellOff = true
	else
		BellSound:Stop()
		BellOff = false
	end
	
end



function module.Invoke(data) -- the main function
	-- must not yield or things will break
	if data.Bell then
		HandleBell()
	end
end

function module.Stop()
	-- this function is called when the Stop command is sent to the locomotive
	module.Invoke({Bell = false})
end

module.Stop()

return module

scripts.name: P40DC.Advanced Weld
scripts.source:
--MADE BY NWSPACEK

--[[ This weld script is cool!
	It will use the structure of models to weld. It treats each model as a separate moving body
	except if name a part "AHandle" and insert a BoolValue named "WeldToRoot" into it.
--]]

wait(1) --thanks PSG

local AvoidWelding = {--add models you want this script to not weld in here
	["Coupler"]=true
}

function weld(i,b)
	local weld1 = Instance.new("Weld") 
	weld1.Name = b.Name
	weld1.Part0 = i
	weld1.Part1 = b
	weld1.C1 = b.CFrame:inverse()*i.CFrame
	weld1.Parent = i
end

function welding(p,ph)
	p:MakeJoints()
	local handle = p:FindFirstChild("AHandle")
	if handle and ph and handle:FindFirstChild("WeldToRoot") then
		weld(handle,ph)
	end
	if not handle then
		for _,j in pairs (p:GetChildren()) do
			if j:IsA("BasePart") then
				handle = j
				break
			end
		end
	end
	if not handle then
		handle = ph
	end
	for _,j in pairs (p:GetChildren()) do
		if j:IsA("BasePart") then
			weld(handle,j)
		elseif j:IsA("Model") and not AvoidWelding[j.Name] then
			welding(j,handle)
		end
	end
end

function unanchoring(p)
	for _,j in pairs (p:GetChildren()) do
		if j:IsA("BasePart") then
			j.Anchored = false
		elseif j:IsA("Model") then
			unanchoring(j)
		end
	end
end

wait(1)
welding(script.Parent)
wait(0.5)
unanchoring(script.Parent)

scripts.name: P40DC.RoGaugeCoupler.RoGaugeCouplerScript
scripts.source:
-- MADE BY NWSPACEK

local coupler = script.Parent

local DCCPermissions = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("DCCPermissions")
local function GetPermission()
	-- if DCCPermissions isn't found, everything is allowed
	return true
end
if DCCPermissions then
	-- if DCCPermissions is found, get permission
	DCCPermissions = require(DCCPermissions)
	function GetPermission(player,action)
		return DCCPermissions.GetPermission(player,action)
	end
end

local Allow = coupler:FindFirstChild("Allow")
local CoupledTo = coupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo")
local DelayedTo = coupler:FindFirstChild("DelayedTo")
local remote = coupler:FindFirstChild("ROBLOXInteractionEvent")
local Attachment = coupler:FindFirstChild("Attachment")

if not Allow then
	Allow = Instance.new("BoolValue")
	Allow.Name = "Allow"
	Allow.Value = true
	Allow.Parent = coupler
end
if not CoupledTo then
	CoupledTo = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	CoupledTo.Name = "CoupledTo"
	CoupledTo.Parent = coupler
end
if not DelayedTo then
	DelayedTo = Instance.new("ObjectValue")
	DelayedTo.Name = "DelayedTo"
	DelayedTo.Parent = coupler
end
if not remote then
	remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
	remote.Name = "ROBLOXInteractionEvent"
	remote.Parent = coupler
end
if not Attachment then
	Attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	Attachment.Axis = Vector3.new(0,0,-1)
	Attachment.Parent = coupler
end

local Rod -- the rod itself
local RodConnection -- connection to decouple if the rod disappears

local TouchedConnection

local function Recolor()--this makes the indicator change colors
	if CoupledTo.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright green") -- green means coupled
	elseif DelayedTo.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright blue") -- orange means delayed (will automatically set Allow once delayed coupler is out of range)
	elseif Allow.Value then
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright yellow") -- yellow means ready to couple
	else
		coupler.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red") -- red means will not couple
	end
end
Recolor()

do --[[ Create a coupling ]]--
	
	local function GetCouplerOwner(otherCoupler)
		-- sets the network owner of the coupler to the server
		-- and determines who should get control of the coupler after coupling
		
		local owner = coupler:GetNetworkOwner() -- network owner of our coupler
		local otherOwner = otherCoupler:GetNetworkOwner() -- network owner of the other coupler
		
		local ownerAuto = coupler:GetNetworkOwnershipAuto() -- auto ownership of our coupler
		local otherOwnerAuto = otherCoupler:GetNetworkOwnershipAuto() -- auto ownership of other coupler
		
		-- set both coupler ownerships to server to perform the coupling
		if coupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			coupler:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end
		if otherCoupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			coupler:SetNetworkOwner(nil)
		end
		
		local NewCouplerOwner
		-- nil means set the network owner to the server
		-- false is taken to mean set network ownership auto
		
		if NewCouplerOwner and otherOwnerAuto then
			-- if both couplers were set to automatic ownership, set automatic ownership
			NewCouplerOwner = false
		elseif ownerAuto then
			-- if this coupler has automatic ownership and the other doesn't, set it to the owner of the other coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = otherOwner
		elseif otherOwnerAuto then
			-- if the other coupler has automatic ownership and this coupler doesn't, set it to the owner of this coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = owner
		else
			-- if neither coupler had automatic ownership, set ownership to the owner of this coupler
			NewCouplerOwner = owner
		end
		
		return NewCouplerOwner
	end
	
	local function RestoreCouplerOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
		-- sets the ownership or auto ownership of the coupler after coupling
		if coupler:CanSetNetworkOwnership() then
			if NewCouplerOwner == false then
				-- auto ownership
				coupler:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
			else
				-- any other kind of ownership (including server)
				coupler:SetNetworkOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
			end
		end
	end
	
	function RemoveTouchedConnection()
		-- disconnect the TouchedConnection because they create a lot of lag with Ro-Gauge trains
		if TouchedConnection then
			TouchedConnection:disconnect()
			TouchedConnection = nil
		end
	end
	
	local function Couple(OtherCoupler)
		-- set the coupler parts to cancollide false so they don't interfere with each other when coupled
		coupler.CanCollide = false
		OtherCoupler.CanCollide = false
		
		Rod = Instance.new("RodConstraint")
		Rod.Name = "RoGaugeRod"
		Rod.Visible = false
		Rod.Length = coupler.Size.Z/2+OtherCoupler.Size.Z/2
		Rod.Attachment0 = Attachment
		Rod.Attachment1 = OtherCoupler.Attachment
		Rod.Parent = coupler
		CreateRodConnection()
		
		CoupledTo.Value = OtherCoupler
		OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = coupler
		if coupler:FindFirstChild("CoupleSound") then
			coupler.CoupleSound:Play()
		end
	end
	
	local function HandleTouched(OtherCoupler)
		if not Allow.Value or CoupledTo.Value then
			-- if we aren't allowing or we are already coupled, ignore
			return
		end
		if OtherCoupler.Name ~= "RoGaugeCoupler" then
			-- if the part is not a RoGaugeCoupler, ignore
			return
		end
		local OtherAllow = OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("Allow")
		local OtherCoupledTo = OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo")
		
		if OtherCoupledTo.Value or OtherAllow.Value == false then
			-- if the other coupler is coupled or it is not allowing, ignore
			return
		end
		-- lets couple
		-- set network owner to server to perform coupling
		local NewCouplerOwner = GetCouplerOwner(OtherCoupler)
		-- perform coupling
		Couple(OtherCoupler)
		RemoveTouchedConnection()
		-- set network owner to the deserving party
		RestoreCouplerOwner(NewCouplerOwner)
	end
	
	function AddTouchedConnection()
		if TouchedConnection then
			return
		end
		TouchedConnection = coupler.Touched:connect(HandleTouched)
	end
	AddTouchedConnection()
end

do --[[ Destroy a coupling ]]--
	local function DelayCouplers()
		local OtherCoupler = CoupledTo.Value
		OtherCoupler.DelayedTo.Value = coupler -- set the other coupler's DelayedTo value
		DelayedTo.Value = CoupledTo.Value -- set this coupler's DelayedTo value
		
		-- insert a spring connecting the two couplers with zero force
		-- this forces them to be the same mechanism and thus the same network owner
		local s = Instance.new("SpringConstraint")
		s.Name = "RoGaugeSpring"
		s.Damping = 0
		s.MaxForce = 0
		s.Stiffness = 0
		s.Visible = false
		s.Attachment0 = Attachment
		s.Attachment1 = OtherCoupler.Attachment
		s.Parent = coupler
		CoupledTo.Value = nil
		OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = nil
	end
	
	local function Decouple()
		coupler.CanCollide = true
		Allow.Value = false--this makes it so that it won't re-connect right after you uncouple
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			local OtherCoupler = CoupledTo.Value
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeRod") then
				-- delete the coupler connection
				OtherCoupler.RoGaugeRod:Destroy()
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("Allow") then
				-- set it to not couple back up immediately
				OtherCoupler.Allow.Value = false
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("CoupledTo") then
				-- set it so it isn't coupled
				OtherCoupler.CoupledTo.Value = nil
			end
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("DecoupleSound") then
				coupler.DecoupleSound:Play()
			end
		end
		if RodConnection then
			RodConnection:Disconnect()
			RodConnection = nil
		end
		if Rod then
			Rod:Destroy()
		end
		Recolor()
		CoupledTo.Value = nil
		if DelayedTo.Value then
			local OtherCoupler = DelayedTo.Value
			local Halflength = OtherCoupler.Size.Z/2+coupler.Size.Z/2
			while (OtherCoupler.Position-coupler.Position).magnitude < Halflength*1.5 and DelayedTo.Value == OtherCoupler do
				wait()
			end
			if OtherCoupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				OtherCoupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				coupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			DelayedTo.Value = nil
			Allow.Value = true
			Recolor()
		end
		AddTouchedConnection()
	end
	
	local function HandlePlayerInput(player)
		-- user input
		if not GetPermission(player,"Coupling") then
			return
		end
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			-- if we are coupled, uncoupled
			DelayCouplers()
			Recolor()
		elseif DelayedTo.Value then
			if coupler:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeSpring") then
				coupler.RoGaugeSpring:Destroy()
			end
			DelayedTo.Value = nil
			Allow.Value = false
			Recolor()
		else
			-- otherwise, toggle Allow
			Allow.Value = not Allow.Value
			if Allow.Value then
				AddTouchedConnection()
			else
				RemoveTouchedConnection()
			end
			Recolor()
		end
	end
	
	remote.OnServerEvent:connect(HandlePlayerInput)
	
	function CreateRodConnection()
		if RodConnection then return end
		RodConnection = Rod.AncestryChanged:connect(function(parent,parento)
			if not parento then
				RodConnection:Disconnect()
				RodConnection = nil
				Decouple()
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local function GetRod()
		if Rod then return end
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			Rod = CoupledTo.Value:FindFirstChild("RoGaugeRod")
			if Rod then
				CreateRodConnection()
			end
		end
	end
	
	local function CoupledToChanged()
		-- if we get the message to decouple, do so
		if CoupledTo.Value then
			GetRod()
			Recolor()
		else
			Decouple()
		end
	end
	
	CoupledTo.Changed:connect(CoupledToChanged)
end
